title: snapshot.baseline_emitted payload
description: M4B § 'Save files are smaller': baseline snapshot in the delta chain. Emitted every `delta_baseline_cadence_ticks` (default 600 = 10 s @ 60 Hz) at the binding tick. Subsequent `snapshot.delta_emitted` events reference this baseline by `event_id`.

state.description: Full canonical world state at this tick. Opaque payload (per-actor + per-chunk + per-projectile).

state_checksum_hex.description: Canonical-JSON BLAKE3 of `state`. The reconstructor cross-checks the per-baseline integrity.
